_comment: CANONICAL SITE: packages/docs/ (Nextra 3, Next.js 15 App Router, output: export).
This config was audited against the actual deployed site structure in July 2026.
TO APPLY: Go to https://crawler.algolia.com, create a new crawler,
paste this config, replace the placeholder credentials below, and run.
CREDENTIALS: appId and apiKey must be replaced with real values.
Apply for DocSearch at https://docsearch.algolia.com/ using the URL
https://docs.iln.finance. Do not commit real credentials here.
SITEMAP NOTE: packages/docs uses `output: export` (static HTML) without
a sitemap plugin, so no sitemap.xml is generated. The crawler discovers
pages via discoveryPatterns instead. Add next-sitemap to packages/docs
and restore the sitemaps entry when a sitemap is available.
